[[File:DoubleChunkCookieNom.ogg]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Chocolate bunny|Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Melted Chocolate''' emote is an emote that could be obtained at Level 28 of the premium [[Ducky Revenge Event#Ducky Revenge Battle Pass|Ducky Revenge Battle Pass]]. It was made by StarWars and Fybirr. The player can move while performing the emote and interact with it. No music can be heard while performing the emote and the emote itself is not looped. '''Melted Chocolate''' will make the player grab out a giant chocolate bunny cookie, saying "''Mmmm! Hubby wubby chocolate bunny!''". The player holds the chocolate bunny cookie with both hands. When interacted, the player will take a bite out of the chocolate bunny three times, with the final bite being done by throwing what remains of the chocolate bunny up into the air, which then falls into the player's mouth. It had a cost of {{DuckyEggs|940}} or {{Robux|86}} ({{Robux|73}} during the Memorial Day 2025 Sale) to unlock it, with a total cost of {{DuckyEggs|12,510}} or {{Robux|2,152}} ({{Robux|1,816}} during the Memorial Day 2025 Sale). ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Melted Chocolate''' added. **{{Bug}} Chocolate bunny is not held correctly by the player during the idle animation. **{{Bug}} Going into first person then into third person after a part of the chocolate bunny has been eaten will visually reset the chocolate bunny. **{{Bug}} Chocolate bunny floats in the inventory emote preview. **{{Bug}} Sound is affected by [[Time Scale]]. *'''11 June 2025''' - [[v1.66.0|v1.66.1]]a **'''Melted Chocolate''' is no longer obtainable. *'''22 April 2026''' - [[v1.89.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Chocolate bunny no longer floats in the inventory emote preview. {{EmoteNavBox}}
